WF-03 Step Final: Git Merge and Cleanup (fn:git-merge)

All prior steps completed successfully. GitHub issue 406 is closed. Ready to merge.

Your tasks:
1. Ensure you are on feature/WF03-gh406-20260803 branch
2. Fetch and rebase on origin/main if needed
3. Create GitHub PR via gh pr create
4. Verify all checks pass (if CI is configured)
5. Merge via gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch
6. Verify branch deleted from GitHub
7. Checkout main and pull
8. Verify clean state
9. Record PR number and merge commit SHA in handoff result
acceptance_criteria: Local repo on main with clean state

result.summary: GitHub PR #410 created and merged successfully. Feature branch deleted from GitHub. Repository returned to main with clean state.
